headline.title: Take our I/O 2026 quiz, vibe coded in Google AI Studio.
headline.summary: Google AI Studio has been utilized to create a quiz centered around the key announcements from I/O 2026. The interactive quiz aims to engage users by testing their knowledge of the event's highlights.

articles.title: 9 demos of Gemini Omni and Gemini 3.5 in action
articles.summary: The article showcases nine demonstrations of the Gemini Omni and Gemini 3.5 AI models, highlighting their capabilities and features. These demos illustrate the advancements in AI technology and the practical applications of the Gemini series.

articles.title: Botnet of more than 17 million devices dismantled
articles.summary: A botnet consisting of over 17 million devices has been dismantled, with connections to a Russia-based residential proxy network. The operation highlights ongoing efforts to combat large-scale cyber threats.

articles.title: After Nvidia’s $20B not-aqui-hire, AI chip startup Groq reportedly raising $650M
articles.summary: AI chip startup Groq is reportedly seeking to raise $650 million in funding as it shifts its focus from hardware development to enhancing AI inference capabilities. This move follows Nvidia's recent $20 billion acquisition, which has influenced the competitive landscape in the AI chip market.

articles.title: Amazon Is Making an AI-Animated ‘Good Advice Cupcake’ TV Show. Its Original Creator Is Furious
articles.summary: Amazon is developing an AI-animated TV show based on "The Good Advice Cupcake," a character originally created by Loryn Brantz for BuzzFeed. Brantz has expressed anger over the licensing of her character for the series without her consent.

articles.title: Boston Children’s uses AI to unlock new diagnoses
articles.summary: Boston Children's Hospital is utilizing OpenAI technology to enhance patient care and streamline operations, successfully diagnosing over 40 rare disease cases. This initiative aims to improve diagnostic accuracy and efficiency in pediatric healthcare.

articles.title: Check out real-life AI prototypes from the Futures Lab.
articles.summary: Students at the University of Waterloo have created AI prototypes, including sign language tutors, aimed at transforming education and workplace interactions. These projects were developed as part of the university's Futures Lab initiative.

articles.title: So you’ve heard these AI terms and nodded along; let’s fix that
articles.summary: The article provides a glossary of key AI terms and phrases to help readers better understand the rapidly evolving language of artificial intelligence. It aims to clarify common jargon associated with AI, making the technology more accessible to a wider audience.

articles.title: Hands-On With Gemini Spark: I Gave It Access to My Life and It Friend-Zoned My Boyfriend
articles.summary: Google's new AI agent, Gemini Spark, analyzed personal data such as emails and calendars to assist in planning a birthday party but failed to recognize the user's boyfriend as a significant figure. The experience highlights the limitations of AI in understanding personal relationships despite its organizational capabilities.

articles.title: What happens when companies become too AI-pilled?
articles.summary: Box founder Aaron Levie warns that decision-makers pushing for AI to replace jobs often lack a true understanding of those roles, a phenomenon he describes as "AI psychosis." Recent layoffs, such as ClickUp's 22% workforce reduction for AI agents, highlight the growing trend of companies relying on AI, with tech layoffs in 2026 approaching the total for all of 2025.

articles.title: Today is the last day to apply to speak at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.summary: Today is the final day to submit applications to speak at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Interested individuals can propose session topics to contribute to discussions shaping the future of the tech industry.

articles.title: Final 24 hours to save up to $410 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
articles.summary: Early Bird ticket sales for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 end tonight at 11:59 p.m. PT, offering savings of up to $410. The event, scheduled for October, is expected to attract over 10,000 tech leaders.
